title: A cold Friday, in the garden of the royal chancery… | Folio 5 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
A cold Friday, in the garden of the royal chancery. An old secretary has just carried the sultan's letters in and out, as he has done for nearly thirty years. He sits down, and suddenly his body will not obey him. His young assistant, who will one day write it all down, is not far away.

The full story: Folio 5: The Secretary Who Kept the Sultan's Secrets — on our channel and on every podcast app.
